text: As the Patriots prepare for their Week 3 road trip to Jacksonville, the offense faces mounting concerns with starting right guard Mike Onwenu sidelined by a broken right ankle, forcing adjustments up front against the Jaguars' defense. On the bright side, Mike Reiss reports that rookie tight end Eli Raridon has returned to practice and is being monitored for Sunday's matchup, offering some optimism at a position the team needs reinforcement on. The Patriots also made moves to bolster their linebacker corps, promoting Jose Ramirez from the practice squad to the 53-man roster while signing Benton Whitley to the practice squad, while safety Dell Pettus landed on injured reserve. The team will take the field at Everbank Stadium on Sunday at 1 PM ET looking to build on last week's defensive effort against the Steelers—though as one report noted, the offensive rhythm that fueled last season's Super Bowl run remains a work in progress with Drake Maye still seeking consistency against quality competition.
